description.en: Shows (or hides) a secondary/"defense-side" purpose text bubble, similar to CMND_BTL_SET_PURPOSETEXT — formatted from a message-table text ID and optionally substituting a character's name into it.
Message-table text ID string (e.g. "d_purpose_021") to display, or 0 to hide the text.
Character ID string whose name is substituted into the text, or 0 when hiding the text.
True once the purpose text has been updated; null if fewer than 2 arguments were given.
